rules.statement: The court found no evidence of fraud that would vitiate the second defendant's title in competition with the plaintiff.
rules.supporting_quote: "I cannot see how the facts above stated amount to fraud, and much less how Supramaniam Chetty or those claiming under him can be said to be affected by it. Even if the first defendant had intended ... there was nothing to prevent her from changing her mind and allowing Juan Samarasekera to take an assignment."
